fix_strategies.name: Parameterized query
fix_strategies.pattern: Replace string concatenation/template SQL with placeholders and bound values

fix_strategies.name: Encode output
fix_strategies.pattern: Render untrusted data as text or sanitize with a trusted HTML sanitizer

fix_strategies.name: Avoid shell
fix_strategies.pattern: Use allowlists and argument arrays; never pass user input into shell command strings

fix_strategies.name: Safe path resolution
fix_strategies.pattern: Normalize path and ensure resolved target remains inside an allowed base directory

fix_strategies.name: Environment-backed secrets
fix_strategies.pattern: Read credentials from environment or secret manager

CWE-918.name: SSRF

fix_strategies.name: URL allowlist and private IP block
fix_strategies.pattern: Validate scheme/host and deny localhost, metadata, and private ranges

anti_patterns: blind URL fetch from user input

fix_strategies.name: Enforce auth middleware
fix_strategies.pattern: Require authenticated principal before sensitive actions

fix_strategies.name: Protect critical routes
fix_strategies.pattern: Add middleware/guard checking session/token and role

fix_strategies.name: Restrict CORS
fix_strategies.pattern: Allow only trusted origins and required methods/headers

CWE-614.name: Sensitive Cookie in HTTPS Session Without Secure Attribute

fix_strategies.name: Fail-closed controls
fix_strategies.pattern: Ensure security checks fail closed and cannot be bypassed
